infra.ausbau.autobahn.name: Motorway and expressway
infra.ausbau.autobahn.kehrseite: New roads attract new traffic; after a few years part of the gain is used up again. Farmers lose land along the route.
infra.ausbau.bahn.name: Upgrade the rail line
infra.ausbau.bahn.text: A second track, electrification and signalling on the existing line.
infra.ausbau.bahn.kehrseite: Fewer trains run during construction; the benefit only comes with the last section.
infra.ausbau.schnellbahn.name: High-speed rail
infra.ausbau.schnellbahn.text: A new route for fast trains, separate from freight.
infra.ausbau.schnellbahn.kehrseite: Very expensive and slow to build; the route cuts through fields, and costs often run away.
infra.ausbau.hafen.name: Port expansion
infra.ausbau.hafen.text: New quays, cranes and rail links in the large seaports.
infra.ausbau.hafen.kehrseite: Without rail and road into the hinterland, the containers just pile up somewhere else.
infra.ausbau.flughafen.name: Terminal and runway
infra.ausbau.flughafen.text: A larger terminal and another runway.
infra.ausbau.flughafen.kehrseite: Noise for residents, land for construction; more flights bring more visitors but also more traffic on the ground.
infra.ausbau.kraftwerk.name: Power plant and lines
infra.ausbau.kraftwerk.text: New generation with substations and lines to the consumers.
infra.ausbau.kraftwerk.kehrseite: Lines and plants meet local resistance; every power plant ties up fuel or land.
infra.ausbau.wasser.name: Reservoir, pipes and treatment plant
infra.ausbau.wasser.text: A reservoir or dam, new pipes without losses and a treatment plant.
infra.ausbau.wasser.kehrseite: A dam floods valleys and villages; water stored here is missing downstream.
infra.ausbau.glasfaser.name: Fibre and mobile
infra.ausbau.glasfaser.text: Fibre into the homes and new radio masts.
infra.ausbau.glasfaser.kehrseite: In sparsely populated areas the rollout never pays; it remains dependent on subsidies.
infra.ausbau.wohnungen.name: Social housing
infra.ausbau.wohnungen.text: New homes through the state housing agency, with schools and transport links.
infra.ausbau.wohnungen.kehrseite: Large estates on the outskirts without jobs nearby become dormitory towns; the building ties up the construction sector.
infra.ausbau.klinik.name: Build a hospital
infra.ausbau.klinik.text: A new hospital with an emergency department and specialist wards.
infra.ausbau.klinik.kehrseite: A building without doctors and nurses stands empty; the staff are then missing elsewhere.
infra.paket.bahnoffensive.name: Rail offensive
infra.paket.bahnoffensive.text: Upgrade rail in the six most strained provinces at once.
infra.paket.wohnungsoffensive.name: Housing offensive
infra.paket.wohnungsoffensive.text: Social housing in the six provinces with the greatest shortage.
infra.paket.klinikoffensive.name: Hospital offensive
infra.paket.klinikoffensive.text: New hospitals in the five provinces with the longest waiting times.
infra.vorhaben.text: {was} More capacity for {netz} in {ort}: plus {plus, number} percent of today's.
infra.pflege.kehrseite: Ties up construction capacity that is then missing for new projects.
infra.alt.strasse.name: Tolls and frequent transit
infra.alt.strasse.text: A peak-hour toll and more frequent buses divert part of the traffic.
infra.alt.bahn.name: More trains on old tracks
infra.alt.bahn.text: Higher frequency and longer trains on the existing line.
infra.alt.hafen.name: Speed up customs clearance
infra.alt.hafen.text: Clear around the clock and check papers digitally.
infra.alt.flughafen.name: Spread flights to nearby airports
infra.alt.flughafen.text: Divert charter flights to smaller airports in the region.
infra.alt.strom.name: Curb peak load
infra.alt.strom.text: Large consumers pay more at peak times and reduce their load.
infra.alt.wasser.name: Reduce pipe losses
infra.alt.wasser.text: Find leaks and replace old pipes instead of tapping new water.
infra.alt.wasser.dagegen: The municipality digs up the streets.
infra.alt.internet.name: Award frequencies
infra.alt.internet.text: Award new radio frequencies to the operators in return for rollout obligations.
infra.alt.internet.dagegen: Operators build first where it pays.
infra.alt.wohnen.name: Cap rent increases
infra.alt.wohnen.text: A ceiling on rent increases relieves tenants immediately.
infra.alt.wohnen.dagegen: Less gets built, and flats disappear from the market.
infra.alt.kliniken.name: Bring in private hospitals
infra.alt.kliniken.text: Insurance pays for treatment in private hospitals until waiting times fall.
infra.alt.kliniken.dagegen: Those who can pay get seen sooner.

infra.log.ueberlast.warum: Demand grows with the economy, the population and visitors faster than capacity. Overload slows the economy and services until someone expands or steers demand.
